newsitem.title: USA: General files to offer 13.8 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: General files to offer 13.8 mln shares.

text.p: General Communication Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 13.8 million Class A common shares.
Of the total amount, seven million shares will be sold by the company and 6.8 million will be offered by selling shareholders, the company said in the filing.
Concurrently with the stock offering, $150 million worth of senior notes due 2007 will be offered to the public by GCI Inc, a wholly-owned subsidary of the company, General said.
Certain selling shareholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 2.07 million additional shares of class A stock.
The offering will made through Salomon Brothers Inc, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and Schroder Wertheim & Co.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 45,164,553 Class A common, the company said.
Net proceeds will be used to reduce borrowings.
General Communication, based in Anchorage, is a diversified telecommunications provider with a leading position in facilities-based long distance service in Alaska.
